definition: LDRA Testbed is a software analysis and testing tool for assessing code quality, coding-standard compliance and test coverage.
entry_text: LDRA Testbed is a software analysis and testing tool for assessing code quality, coding-standard compliance and test coverage.
example: A quality engineer checks embedded software for violations of a project's coding rules.
label: LDRA Testbed

sources.note: LDRA identifies Testbed as the static and dynamic analysis engines and describes coding-standard, quality-metric, and coverage analysis for the Testbed and TBvision combination.
